verdict_a.limit: No native run was performed in this lane. This verifies the diagnostic's ability to distinguish these cases when observed; it does not establish what Chrome returned on the failing run or prove the root cause.

verdict_b.finding: Reuse is good: the diagnostic delegates to the existing observeSidePanelContext helper, avoids raw URLs and exception text, preserves the acceptance guard, and tests distinguish initial classification, exact later appearance, persistent mismatch, and query error. Existing foreign-context refusal coverage remains present. The follow-up is limited to two observer attempts; each cdp.send uses the existing owned CDP transport timeout (default 5,000 ms), which rejects and marks the transport fatal on timeout, so the reviewed path does not wait indefinitely for a stalled CDP command.
